about_short_description.short_description: Therify provides an inclusive mental healthcare service for companies.

product.name: Therify In-Network Mental Health Platform
product.description: A platform that matches employees with licensed, in-network therapists who accept their health insurance to facilitate faster access to mental healthcare and reduce costs.

product.name: Custom Provider Network Design
product.description: A service to create a tailored network of in-network therapists suited to the specific needs of a company's employees and their families.

product.name: Digital Care Navigation
product.description: A service providing dedicated Care Navigators who assist employees in finding and connecting with licensed therapists within their insurance network.

product.name: Provider Vetting
product.description: A process of selecting and verifying mental health providers to ensure quality and suitability within the in-network therapist group.

identifier.value: Custom Mental Health Program Design and Implementation

product.name: Custom Mental Health Program Design and Implementation
product.description: A consulting service to assess organizational wellbeing needs and design, implement, and monitor a tailored mental health program for employees.
